title: 2025 AMC 10A Problem 7
statement: Suppose \(a\) and \(b\) are real numbers. When the polynomial \(x^3 + x^2 + ax + b\) is divided by \(x - 1,\) the remainder is \(4.\) When the polynomial is divided by \(x - 2,\) the remainder is \(6.\) What is \(b - a?\)

solutions.text: By the Remainder Theorem, just plug in. We get \(p(1) = 1 + 1 + a + b = 4,\) so \(a + b = 2.\) And \(p(2) = 8 + 4 + 2a + b = 6,\) so \(2a + b = -6.\) Subtract the first from the second: \(a = -8,\) hence \(b = 10.\) Then \(b - a = 10 - (-8) = 18.\) Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: By the Remainder Theorem, evaluate the polynomial at \(x = 1\) and \(x = 2\)
